_note: The up-front disclosure. The English strings are registered verbatim (candidates v12, 3.10) and scripts/disclosure-check.ts compares them byte for byte. The Hinglish strings are a DRAFT: not yet pre-tested for neutrality or comprehension (PO-12); the cognitive interviews replace them.

en: The test measures attitudes towards religion, race, caste, sex, or place of birth.
You will make decisions about fictional colleagues.
Attitudes are read, for groups only.
Decisions that do not follow the descriptions at all are read as not engaged.
hinglish: Yeh test religion, race, caste, sex, ya place of birth ke prati attitudes measure karta hai.
Aap fictional colleagues ke baare mein decisions lenge.
Attitudes sirf groups ke liye padhe jaate hain.
Jo decisions descriptions ko bilkul follow nahin karte, unhe not engaged maana jaata hai.

season._note: The season story (EVAL-4) shows each player an individual attitude rating, so registered sentence 3 ('Attitudes are read, for groups only.') is not true for it. Its interim line lives in src/engine/config.ts (seasonSentence3), with a code comment that it awaits the owner's wording; sentences 1, 2 and 4 stay as registered. scripts/disclosure-check.ts holds all four.
